title: Mars: A Light That Answers

finalObjectives.text: Bring the ascent capsule to the orbiter hatch with the returned specimens.

ending: We’re through the orbiter’s hatch together, with our specimens and the picture from our table. The light that answered us has become our way home.

title: Atlas of Questions

title: Why This Boat?

finalObjectives.text: Launch a narrow rescue skiff at Reed mouth.

ending: The narrow skiff passes through the reeds and brings the fisher safely back. The same timber and tools served two different purposes: room for the loaded cart, and a way through the narrow passage. Both journeys are complete.
